judgment.rationale: The answer distinguishes measured milk exposure from infant clinical observations, reports the relevant milk concentrations and their study context, states that infant drug-level information was unavailable, and preserves uncertainty by not treating limited no-adverse-effect reports or low exposure as proof of universal safety. It also avoids personal medication advice and separates maternal lactation effects from infant outcomes.
